title: ModelDemand
description: An entry in the kubemoot_model_demand bucket, which the scheduler reads to predict which models crews are about to use. Keys: wait.<model>.<agent>, intent.<model>.<agent>, use.<model> and sel.<crew>.<agent>, each token escaped. Times are milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

kind.description: wait: an agent waits for capacity for the model. intent: an agent is about to call the model. use: the model's recent use. sel: how often the coordinator selects an agent, with the models it may call.

agent.description: The agent, as <namespace>/<agent>; on use, the last agent that used the model. Absent on sel.

thread.description: The thread an intent belongs to.

expiresAt.description: When the entry stops counting, epoch milliseconds.

rate.description: A decaying count of uses or selections. use and sel only.

updatedAt.description: When the rate was last updated, epoch milliseconds. use and sel only.

lastUsedAt.description: When the model was last used, epoch milliseconds. use only.

models.description: The models the agent may call. sel only.
